origin.description: Bias-corrected weighted variance of one vector.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: One weight per entry. Omitted means equal weights that sum to 1. Weights that do not sum to 1 are rescaled.

origin.details: The factor is 1 over 1 minus the sum of squared weights. The weighted mean of squared deviations uses weights that already sum to 1.
